quarterly_data.quarter: X-Energy press release: TRISO-X Advances to Next Phase of Construction for TX-1 (08-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TRISO-X (X-energy subsidiary) began the next construction phase at TX-1 in Oak Ridge, Tennessee - auxiliary buildings, interior build-out of the 214,000 sq. ft. facility and fuel fabrication equipment installation, plus an adjacent graphite matrix powder building - with Clark Construction Group continuing as contractor. Once operational TX-1 is expected to produce 700,000 TRISO-X pebbles per year (5 MTU), enough fuel for up to 11 Xe-100 reactors. TRISO-X also extended its CRADA with Oak Ridge National Laboratory, acquired an additional 70 acres for its Horizon Center campus and won a Tennessee economic development grant.
quarterly_data.figure: 700,000 pebbles per year (5 MTU); up to 11 Xe-100 reactors
